precepts.text: As for the ungodly, wrath came upon them without mercy unto the end: for he knew before what they would do. The chapter before goes into the destruction of Egypt, all the plagues that came. But here is what is very telling: he did not show mercy in his wrath, because he already knew what they were going to do.
precepts.point: It is like a director, a screenplay writer. They write the movie, and you show up as the actor. They give you the script and you read it and say, this is a good movie, who am I going to play? Oh, I am going to be the Black Panther. Somebody may be morally torn by playing Killmonger, but Killmonger is actually the good guy. My point is Michael B. Jordan agreed to that role. Chadwick Boseman agreed to that role. Everybody agreed to their role, and then the movie was made and we all watched it and we were cheering, Wakanda forever. The same way, the Lord sat in his council and everyone was given their roles, their tasks. He already knew who was who, who was ordained to be in this womb.

note.label: Stay in the Spirit

precepts.why:
Ezra says, “And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spake against me. For then every one obeyed.” Before the world was made there was a council, and no one spoke against what was ordained. Christ said, these spirits over here, y’all are the twelve tribes of Israel; those spirits right there, y’all are the Jebusites. No one disagreed. When you are before the creator you are not going to say, no, I don’t want to be the Edomites.

It is like a screenplay writer and a director. You show up as the actor, they give you the script, and you say, this is a good movie, who am I going to play? Michael B. Jordan agreed to play Killmonger; they portrayed him as the bad guy, but Killmonger is actually the good guy. Chadwick Boseman agreed to his role. Everybody agreed to their role, then the movie was made and we cheered, Wakanda forever. The same way the Lord sat in his council and everyone was given their roles and tasks.

Wisdom of Solomon proves he knew beforehand: “As for the ungodly, wrath came upon them without mercy unto the end: for he knew before what they would do.” The chapter before goes into the destruction of Egypt and all the plagues that came. What is very telling is that he did not show mercy in his wrath, because he already knew what they were going to do.

So what Paul said and Peter said, the prophet Ezra says the same: it was ordained before the world was made. Now “the manners of them which are created in this world that is made are corrupted by a perpetual seed”, and the Lord already knew who would be ungodly and dealt with them accordingly.

precepts.text: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations. So how can the Lord know how we are all going to move? Because it is already ordained. As Jeremiah is running around as a little kid playing with other little kids, the Lord said, when you grow up you are going to be a mighty prophet in the earth. The same way, especially with these young men. If I could go back in time and be ten, eleven, twelve years old learning this truth. But the good thing is, learning it when you did is ordained of the Lord. Because if you were ten, eleven, twelve back in the day, you may not have withstood those trials that came to many brothers and sisters back then, when YouTube was not as big as it is now. They did not have every topic and every class online for you to go and watch a class and say, let me get my spirit right. That did not exist. So when I was ten or eleven and a trial came, would I have withstood? Only the Lord knows. The Lord said, I will call you when I need you.

precepts.why:
“Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.” How can the Lord know how we are all going to move? Because it is already ordained, from the council Ezra speaks of, when he prepared the world “which was not yet made” and “no man spake against me.”

Think about it. As Jeremiah is running around as a little kid playing with other little kids, the Lord says, when you grow up, you are going to be a mighty prophet in the earth.

The same way with these young men. If I could go back and be ten, eleven, twelve years old learning this truth! But learning it when you did is ordained of the Lord. If you were ten, eleven, twelve back in the day, you may not have withstood the trials that came to many brothers and sisters then, when YouTube was not as big as it is now. There was not every topic and every class online for you to watch and say, let me get my spirit right. When I was ten or eleven and a trial came, would I have withstood? Only the Lord knows. The Lord said, I will call you when I need you.

That is every single one of us. It is ordained by the Lord for you young ones to be here in 2026, when your parents can send you a class for the spirit you are dealing with, so you are able to abide in this time. Many fell out back then. You were known and set apart before you came out of the womb, called at the time the Lord chose.

precepts.text: For such as in their life have received benefits: that's the riches, the fame, the fortune. And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, when brothers on the street preaching and teaching, and when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it: the same must know it after death by pain.
precepts.point: That verse speaks volumes. Deceivableness: the easy word is deceit. Unrighteousness: sin. All deceit of sin, breaking God's laws. In them that perish, because they received not the love of the truth: this is about our people.

note.label: Drowning in Sin & Perdition

precepts.why:
“For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me”: that's the riches, the fame, the fortune. “And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty”: while the brothers were on the street preaching and teaching.

“and, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it; The same must know it after death by pain.” The door of repentance was open to them, and they despised it.

That is the end of them that perish in 2 Thessalonians 2:10. They received not the love of the truth, God's law, while they had time and liberty, and the same must know it after death by pain.

precepts.text: Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways, and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments. For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me, and they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it; the same must know it after death by pain. Discussed in class: a commentator who said he is not oppressed because he makes ten million dollars a year; that is a benefit received while not knowing God. He once posted Revelation 3:9 with no commentary, got attacked for it, and quickly deleted it. Who says when you die you don't get punished? Nobody escapes.
precepts.point: For it is not a light thing to do wickedly against the laws of God. Sometimes we take the laws of the Most High for granted with the mentality, I can sin and God won't do nothing.

note.label: From Brother To Betrayer

precepts.why:
“For it is not a light thing to do wickedly against the laws of God.” Sometimes we take God’s laws for granted with the mentality, I can sin and God won’t do nothing. Ezra shows otherwise: “Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways: and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments.”

“For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me.” Look at Jason Whitlock. In the interview he said he is not oppressed because he makes ten million dollars a year. That is a benefit. A lot of our people become doctors and make big money and say, if I can do it, you can do it, and they do not know God. Whitlock once posted Revelation 3:9 on his Instagram with no commentary, all Amalek attacked him, and he quickly deleted it. These people need a wake-up call.

“And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it.” They had liberty, because the brothers are out there teaching and the videos are in their feed. They see it, and they hate it.

“The same must know it after death by pain.” So who says that when you die you don’t get punished? You are going to know pain after you die, when Christ returns. Nobody escapes. That is why it is not a light thing to do wickedly against the laws of God, as Jason did.

precepts.text: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee. Where did he know us? In the spirit, before our parents brought us forth. There is something in your spirit that God said, I need to fix you, so that when the time comes you come back to me and not to your pride.
precepts.point: The same must know it after death by pain. This is a God that will kill you and still have pain awaiting. So do not let anybody tell you the place of torment was made up by a church; these scriptures are in the book.

note.label: The Pride Of Thine Heart Hath Deceived Thee!

precepts.why:
Ezra says every one that shall be saved, and shall escape by his works, by keeping the commandments, and by faith in what is written, “Shall be preserved from the said perils, and shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders: for I have sanctified them for me from the beginning.” That is when the kingdom is set up. And why does he say he sanctified them from the beginning? Jeremiah shows it.

“Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee.” Where did he know us? In spirit. This is a physical domain, but he knew us in the spirit world, in another dimension. He did something to our spirit before our parents had relations to bring us forth. You are here because of a conversation God had with you before you even came into this world.

So you people are here because God cares about you. You are not here by accident. There is something in your spirit that God said, I need to fix you, so that when the time comes to destroy the earth, you come back to me and are not in your pride.

The third of Israelites were sanctified from the beginning, from the foundation of the earth. He said, these spirits I am going to love, and these spirits I am going to reject and destroy. God is good all the time to the people that keep his commandments. To you people breaking God’s laws, he is not good. So do not listen to anybody saying God is good all the time; that is not scriptural.

That is why the rest of the chapter is so hard: those who abused his ways, loathed his law while they had liberty and despised the place of repentance “must know it after death by pain.” The sanctified are preserved; the proud are not.

precepts.text: Let the multitude perish which was born in vain: the nations are the extras in the movie, and we are the stars.
precepts.point: Fear thou not, O my servant Jacob: what he says will happen makes us afraid, so we increase our faith by remembering this body is a shell. I will save thee from afar and thy seed from the land of their captivity, and Jacob shall return and be in rest and none shall make him afraid. Though I make a full end of all nations, the extras born in vain with Esau the villain, I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure and not leave thee altogether unpunished.

note.label: From Exile & Tribulation to Promise

precepts.why:
“though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee”. Why is he going to make an end of all nations? Ezra says it: “Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain”.

All these nations were born in vain. In a movie they are the extras; they're not the stars of the movie. We are. And Esau is the villain, the antagonist, the bad guy.

But the stars are not spared from correction: “I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.” The Lord makes a full end of the nations, but only corrects Israel in measure. So “fear thou not, O my servant Jacob”. What he says will happen would make anyone afraid, and nobody wants to go through tribulation, so we increase our faith by reminding ourselves that this body is just a shell; the real us is within. He will save us from afar, and Jacob shall return and be in rest, and none shall make him afraid.

precepts.text: Everyone that shall be saved and escape by his works and by faith whereby ye have believed: works and faith, not one without the other.
precepts.point: Abraham was justified by works when he offered Isaac; faith wrought with his works and by works was faith made perfect, and he was called the friend of God. By works a man is justified and not by faith only, as Romans 2:13 said, and Rahab was justified by works when she sent the spies out another way. As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

note.label: Navigating Through Paul's Letters: Works Of The Law & Liberty

precepts.why:
“Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.” People say the law can’t save you, you are not justified by the works of the law. Ezra answers it: “And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, whereby ye have believed.”

Everyone that shall be saved shall escape by what? His works. And by faith. Works and faith go hand in hand; you have to have both, as James said. You will be saved by both: not faith alone and no works, not faith and no commandments, not commandments and no faith. That makes no sense; it is dead, being alone.

“though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?” That is like a man saying I got a paycheck, with no job. I get paid tomorrow. You got a job? No. It is the dumbest thing you can say out of your mouth. Your faith proves your works and your works prove your faith. Abraham had faith and kept the commandments of God, and his keeping the commandments proved his faith.

And it goes back to the royal law, loving your neighbour as yourself. Telling a brother with no food and no clothes “be ye warmed and filled”, and giving him nothing, makes no damn sense. Even so, faith without works makes no sense: the faith does not exist.

precepts.text: Whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
precepts.point: The angel who spoke to John called himself his fellow servant and his brother.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

precepts.why:
Ezra hears the Lord say, “when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spake against me.” Before the earth was made, his children were with him and they obeyed. Revelation shows that the choosing was done back then: “all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.”

From where? From the foundation of the world. When was your name written in the book of life? At the foundation of the world. That goes back to Genesis 1, when the Lord divided the light from the darkness and separated good from evil. That is predestination.

There is no heathen in that book. I don't care how good you think he is; they are not in the book of life. They are in the book of slavery, the register of chains. Those whose names are not written there worship the beast, because they were not chosen from the foundation of the world. And those who were written there are the ones who, in the beginning, before the world was made, did not speak against him.

precepts.text: I am thy fellow servant, and of thy brethren the prophets.
precepts.point: The angel who spoke to John called himself his fellow servant and his brother.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

precepts.why:
When the world was not yet made, “no man spake against me”: everyone obeyed. We were there with the Lord in the beginning in our angelic bodies, not in this wicked fleshly body. To see what that means, look at the angel who spoke to John.

John fell down to worship before the feet of the angel, and the angel said, “See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.” I am a servant just like you. I am your brother. I am a prophet. And I am of them which keep the sayings of this book. That is heavy.

So now you understand a little more what the Lord means when he says that when we were with him in the beginning, we all obeyed. The angels are our brethren; we had that same celestial body with him before the earth was created, and that is why Christ says those who understand the power of God will be equal unto the angels. Now, covered in this flesh, we are rebellious, and the Lord has to keep whooping us for our idols and our evil. But you have to see who you are and believe it. This is not a fairy tale; this is real.

precepts.text: We have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
precepts.point: The angel who spoke to John called himself his fellow servant and his brother.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

precepts.why:
Before the world was made, everyone obeyed, because we were not in the flesh. Paul shows the body we had and will have again: “For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.” If this body is dissolved, we have a body, not made with hands like Adam formed of the dust of the ground, but eternal in the heavens: a celestial body.

“For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven”. We groan in this body because it is susceptible to sin, and we want our body from heaven. “If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.” That is what Adam's nakedness was: not running around naked, but being in the flesh. Before, he had a spiritual body; God took his spirit and put it in the flesh. That nakedness is the shame, the sinful nature.

We groan “not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.” We want our immortal body. “we walk by faith, not by sight”, “willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.”

So when you die keeping the commandments, you are present with the Lord. This is for every brother and sister who is sick, who has been told they do not have long to live, and for those who have passed away: we understand where they are. Don't be afraid. Conquer that fear. If you did what was right on this earth and dealt right with the saints, absent from this body, you will be with the Lord.

precepts.text: When I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spake against me: then every one obeyed.
precepts.point: The glory the Father gave him he has given us, because we had it before; and where he is now is where his children will be when paradise comes down here.

note.label: Escape Thankskilling : Oh God & My Lord

precepts.text: The law perisheth not but remaineth in his force; the dietary law did not change.
precepts.point: The law perisheth not, but remaineth in his force; that law did not change at all. Do not let anybody confuse you, especially if you are new in the truth: eat what the Most High instructed you to eat.

note.label: Leviticus 11: The Dietary Law of Clean and Unclean Beasts

precepts.why:
“Notwithstanding the law perisheth not, but remaineth in his force.” The dietary law did not change at all. “ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy” is still the word, and the way to be holy in what you eat is still the law of the beasts.

Do not let anybody confuse you, especially if you are new in the truth. The law of the beast and of the fowl and of every living creature remains in force: eat what the Most High instructed you to eat, and make the difference between the unclean and the clean.

precepts.text: Those who abused God's ways and cast his words away shall dwell in torment; having had liberty and despised repentance, they shall know it after death by pain.
precepts.point: Christ sat with sinners, but he was correcting them and showing them righteousness, not indulging their sin. We go to the streets to talk with sinners and give them the scriptures the same way.

note.label: Psalm 7: David's Prayer for Deliverance in the Last Days

precepts.why:
Ezra shows what happens when the space for repentance is over. “Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways: and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments. For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me; And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it; The same must know it after death by pain.”

Those who abused God's ways and cast his words away shall dwell in torment. They had liberty and a place of repentance open to them, and they despised it; so they must know it after death by pain.

That is the end of the wicked God is angry with every day. The mercy of Christ holds back his fury now and keeps the place of repentance open. Those who use that time to repent are judged as the righteous; those who loathe his law while they have liberty know it after death.

precepts.text: Hear O Israel, I sow My law in you and it shall bring forth fruit; the law has to be sown in our minds, which is why we are told to study, pray, and apply.
precepts.point: Rejoice in the Lord ye righteous, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness. He did not forget us; He chastened us for a little but He did not forget, and He is going to remember the covenant.

note.label: Psalm 97: A Fire Goeth Before Him

precepts.why:
Light is sown for the righteous, and the Most High says himself what he sows. “Hear me, O Israel; and mark my words, thou seed of Jacob. For, behold, I sow my law in you, and it shall bring fruit in you, and ye shall be honoured in it for ever.”

The law has to be sown in our minds, and that is why we are told to study, pray and apply. Sown that way, it brings forth fruit in us: the fruits of repentance, loving the Lord and loving our neighbour. That is the gladness of the upright in heart, and we give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness because he did not forget us. He chastened us for a little, but he did not forget, and he is going to remember the covenant.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 8 A Star Called Wormwood

precepts.why:
Remember, these times now are the last days. “And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, whereby ye have believed,” We all want to be saved and to escape during this troublous time; none of us want to be here during that time. Ezra gives us the key right here, and this is for the lazy brothers and the lazy sisters amongst us who want to sit back and have everyone else do the work for them. If you have been with us a year or two years and you have no duty here in this truth, meditate on this verse. If you have no works in this truth you are just here abiding your time. Some people think God is stupid. When the evil rebellion came, December 2018 into 2019, you had people amongst us liking evil videos, and they are sitting here with us, and when you try to check them on it: relax, you're overthinking it. No, sister, we're not overthinking nothing, and don't think we're stupid; God sees you. But you want to marry that sister? That sister right there hates our guts; she's just here. When we were trying to resolve things in the kitchen and put some people in place, some sisters left with other sisters; those sisters ain't here for the truth. Because you get removed from your position in the kitchen you go to a different class, or you ain't coming no more, sitting in the back not talking to nobody: you are not here for God; your god is that woman you attached yourself to, you fool. That woman can't get you into no damn kingdom. As soon as one sister gets moved a whole bunch of sisters follow her: you just revealed yourself. You brothers too: we reprimand a brother and he starts acting funny; you are not here for God and the Most High can't use you. You never believed; you were just looking for a club to join, and you are of the world. The scripture says nothing shall move you from the love of God. People come in quiet, ask for a position, and as soon as their friend gets in trouble and doesn't come, they don't come. The Lord is proving us, like coming out of Egypt: there are dirty spirits, ashy black devils up in here, just to prove you. They take you away from your position and you change; that means you were here just for the position's sake. Maybe those sisters that told on Peter, that's you. Like the Cointelpro thing: some of them come and work their way up the ranks, get a position, but their true intent gets revealed in time. If you take a position in the kitchen, something as simple as a kitchen, your job should make that kitchen run the best so the men can do what they have to do; not, this sister doesn't want to come there any more so I'm not coming. You're fake; nobody should trust you or believe you. Remember Martha complained that her sister wanted to learn; Christ dismissed her: you worry about small things. A sister taken out of security asked why; maybe the Lord is proving you: you are not here for the position, you are here to do the work of the Lord, and everything you are being proved, tried in the fire. You have to tell you why they took your position? You are fake like a fake dollar bill made in your house. Faith and works are in the same sentence: if you are here two, three, four, five, six years and you have no works, something is wrong with you, because you can tell somebody's faith by their works. When I was young in the truth I always wanted to do something; that is the spirit a righteous man is going to have. If you say I don't care about rank, this is not the place for you: didn't the apostles argue about who would sit next to Christ? That is rank. You don't care about the kingdom, Negro. The Bishop came into the old school watering plants, sitting on the floor, doing any little task, and those are the type of people the Most High moves to the top, like when Jesse's sons were anointed: David was with the sheep, the one with the meek and humble spirit became the greatest king over Israel. You silly people fighting over a spot in the kitchen don't believe in God, and you sisters that followed them don't believe either; you are a woman pleaser. We are trying to push one mind, one spirit, one soul, unity among our people, and a brother or sister not dealing with unity needs to get the hell out of here; you make one mistake and we send you to learn online, the stay-at-home deluxe package, and don't try to come to Philly.

By his works and by faith: you can't have just faith alone; you have to have works. Whereby ye have believed: people come into the truth believing based upon the spirit that is upon the brothers teaching. The dude that was over North Carolina thought in his mind that the people came in because of him as an outstanding teacher, and that was not so; even some of those dudes that left thought that; the one said I built this. Well, do it again. Let's see you do it again. The spirit is working with the brothers you see, just like with Moses: God said I will take the spirit that is on you and put it on the seventy; and Christ breathed on them and said receive the spirit. When people say I'm going to leave and do my own thing, it doesn't work like that; that is not how the spirit of God works. They leave, but the spirit stays here; that is why they bug out after they leave, and even the way they teach is not the same, because the spirit stays here and doesn't leave with you.

“Shall be preserved from the said perils,” We shall be saved, preserved from the said perils. “and shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders: for I have sanctified them for me from the beginning.” Those of us that are elect have already been sanctified for God from the beginning of time. “Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways:” This is those of you who hear this truth and sit here murmuring and grumbling, with issues, hating this one secretly and that one. “and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments.” The Bible says you are going to dwell in torments, because we have given you the ways, the keys of the kingdom, and you despitefully abuse God's ways. You sit here, you murmur, you mumble, you have hatred against certain brothers and certain sisters; the Bible says you shall dwell in torments. The day is coming when you are going to know who the fake prophet is: that day when you burn up.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 10 The Little Book, Sweet and Bitter

precepts.why: “Measure thou the time diligently in itself.” “Wherein the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made”: a time soon to come. “Therefore when there shall be seen earthquakes and uproars of the people in the world.” “Even so the times also of the Highest have plain beginnings in wonder and powerful works, and endings in effects and signs”: in the time of Moses there were wonders and powerful works, but in these last days people are not going to be running through the earth with power like Moses had; it is effects and signs. “And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith”: you better have works in this truth. “For I have sanctified them for me from the beginning”: the elect has already been chosen, and works and faith are the evidence that you are part of the elect. “And they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments”: those that were in this truth and cast God’s laws aside and created new doctrines. “And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty”: talking about our people. “The same must know it after death by pain”: right now when people die they are at rest, as the book of Job tells you, but when Christ returns the final judgment begins. If your mama heard the truth and rejected it, she will be judged for that; this is not talking about those who never heard. “And therefore be thou not curious how the ungodly shall be punished, and when: but enquire how the righteous shall be saved, whose the world is, and for whom the world is created”: the world was created for the righteous Israelites.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 14 Part 2

precepts.why: “The same must know it after death by pain.” We think this life is it, but there is a spiritual world. When some are translated, I use that word instead of death, they are going to suffer major punishment. There is no escape; nobody gets away with nothing.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 2 Message to the 7 Churches

precepts.why:
“And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spake against me.” This is the Lord speaking, talking about the Israelites. We were all with him in the very beginning, before he prepared the world. That is why no man spake against him: we were there, and we were all in agreement to what God’s plan was.

In the beginning, before everything was made, in the spirit world God chose certain spirits to come down on the earth as the Israelites, and we all agreed in that counsel. Now we are here in this flesh with no remembrance of the things that happened. Your new name is your true name.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 21 Thy Kingdom Come

precepts.why: The duality of New Jerusalem. “And pray unto the Highest continually, then will I come and talk with thee”: this is the archangel Uriel speaking to Esdras. Esdras was fasting, eating the herbs of the field, and the Lord was about to show him many things.

points: He answered me then, and said, Measure thou the time diligently in itself. So we have to measure the time diligently. How do we measure the time? By the events that are going on in this world. By watching the news.
And when thou seest part of the signs past, which I have told thee before. When you see the signs passing, wars and rumours of wars, earthquakes in divers places.

note.label: Abya Yala Under Fire

points: Then shalt thou understand, that it is the very same time, wherein the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made. Then we understand that it is the time when the Most High is going to begin to visit the world. The Most High is visiting the world with destruction. But it is all for the repentance of God's people. God's people are the Israelites, the so-called blacks, Latinos and Native Americans.

note.label: Abya Yala Under Fire

points: Therefore when there shall be seen earthquakes and uproars of the people in the world. You see that? We have seen earthquakes in Venezuela, earthquakes in Colombia, earthquakes in Peru. Uproars in Argentina, uproars all over Latin America.

note.label: Abya Yala Under Fire

points: Then shalt thou well understand, that the most High spake of those things from the days that were before thee, even from the beginning. Then we understand why these things are happening. So what are we going to do? We have to show the people. It is not a coincidence. It is not osmosis. These things are happening because God wants us to repent.

note.label: Abya Yala Under Fire

points: For like as all that is made in the world hath a beginning and an end, and the end is manifest. The end is manifest.

note.label: Abya Yala Under Fire

points: Even so the times also of the Highest have plain beginnings in wonder and powerful works, and endings in effects and signs.

points: And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, whereby ye have believed. How do we escape this destruction? How do we escape this evil? By his works. What are your works? Keeping God's commandments. Going out and teaching your people repentance. Teaching your people their nationality. All these things are your works. And what else do you have to have? And by faith. Faith in Jesus Christ. Faith in the real Christ. The Christ of the Bible was a black man. Just like the people you see suffering in Latin America. Just like the people you see suffering in Africa. All these things have to happen for the repentance of our people.

note.label: Abya Yala Under Fire

points: And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spake against me. So before the world was made there was a council, and the Lord says no one spoke against what was ordained.

note.label: Stay in the Spirit

points: For then every one obeyed: but now the manners of them which are created in this world that is made are corrupted by a perpetual seed.

So prior to the world being made there were discussions being had, meaning there were others there. Here we have a prophet, Esdras, saying before the earth was made it was already pre-ordained that everyone agreed to whatever Christ said. So there are all these spirits. Christ said, these spirits over here, you are the twelve tribes of Israel. Those spirits right there, you are the Jebusites. It was already ordained, and no one disagreed. Because when you are before the creator you are not going to disagree, like, no, I do not want to be the Edomites.

note.label: Stay in the Spirit

points: Then I considered, and there was great labour, and I saw, and spared it greatly, and have kept me a grape of the cluster, and a plant of a great people. Which is the nation of Israel, the elect of Israel. The Lord says there is a great cluster of grapes that I have kept, kept from destruction. That is the one third.

note.label: Stay in the Spirit

points: Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain; and let my grape be kept, and my plant; for with great labour have I made it perfect. They were born in vain. It is better that they had not been born. Why? Because this is the group the betrayers come from. This is the group that the slanderers and the haters of our people come from. There is nothing profitable to emerge from this vain group. Nothing. Just confusion, just a casting up of dust, just a loud noise from a multitude. It is never anything productive. Show me the Christian men that are standing up manfully against oppression. Let me see the exceeding great army of Christianity. It does not exist.

And with great labour have I made it perfect. So God says there is great labour behind getting brothers and sisters in the right spirit. It is a great labour that the Lord is doing. I know it looks like the Lord has forgotten about us, we are scattered throughout the four corners of the earth. But think about where we were to where we are now spiritually. The Lord has done a mighty work.

note.label: Stay in the Spirit

points: Measure thou the time diligently in itself: and when thou seest part of the signs past, meaning fulfilled, then shalt thou understand that it is the very same time wherein the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made.

note.label: Beginning of Sorrows & Great Pain

points: Therefore when there shall be seen earthquakes and uproars of the people in the world. Are we seeing earthquakes taking place all over the world? Are we seeing uproars amongst the people all over the world? Then shalt thou well understand that the Most High spake of those things from the days that were before thee: the days of Daniel, of Jeremiah, of Isaiah, even all the way back in Genesis. The Most High spoke about these things from the beginning.

note.label: Beginning of Sorrows & Great Pain

points: Like as all that is made in the world hath a beginning and an end, even so the times of the Highest have plain beginnings in wonder and powerful works, and endings in effects and signs. Before this earth ends you are going to see a lot of signs and effects. There will be sorrows, there will be pain, things you cannot even imagine happening on this earth.

note.label: Beginning of Sorrows & Great Pain

points: And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works: by you keeping the commandments, by you doing what is right, by you dealing right with your brothers. And by faith: by you believing in the Lord. If you have faith and works, the Lord will preserve you from the said perils, the dangers, those sorrows that are coming upon the earth, and you shall see his salvation in his land and within his borders: for we were sanctified for the Lord from the beginning.

note.label: Beginning of Sorrows & Great Pain

points: Measure thou the time diligently in itself: and when thou seest part of the signs past, then shalt thou understand that it is the very same time wherein the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made. That is the time we are living in right now.

The last time these people turned into their real nature was World War II: over 80 million people died. This time it is going to be billions. After 1945 they had time to reflect, decided to change their image to the world, gave the slaves some rights, set up a system they called justice and equality, and opened their countries to the people they had colonized and oppressed. Decades later they are saying they should never have let any of them in. That is what you see happening in Europe and in America.

note.label: Seeking Justice in an Unjust System

points: When there shall be seen earthquakes: there was an earthquake in the Philippines this week. And uproars of the people in the world: the white man is rising up all over Europe and all over America saying he does not want black people around him anymore. We are seeing uproars all over the earth, civil unrest, just as God said from the days that were before.

note.label: Seeking Justice in an Unjust System

points: They that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it: you hated God's laws while the place of repentance was open. That place of repentance is open today.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

points: The same must know it after death by pain. After you die, you are going to understand God's laws by pain. That shows Christ has power over your spirit after you die. He said do not fear him that can only destroy the flesh; fear him that has power over the soul. If our people do not repent, they will feel pain after death.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

points: Every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, whereby ye have believed, shall be preserved from the said perils, and shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders: for I have sanctified them for me from the beginning. You are here because God cares about you; you are not here by accident.

note.label: The Pride Of Thine Heart Hath Deceived Thee!

points: Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways. You come into the school and we tell you God's ways, and now you are mad; and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments.

note.label: The Pride Of Thine Heart Hath Deceived Thee!

points: For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me: you will see people prospering in their pride with the house and the car, and they do not know God. And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it. The liberty is us in the streets going all over the world opening the door of repentance; the brothers at camp are running up to people with flyers and they throw them down.

note.label: The Pride Of Thine Heart Hath Deceived Thee!

points: The same must know it after death by pain. This is a God that will kill you and still have pain awaiting. So do not let anybody tell you the place of torment was made up by a church; these scriptures are in the book.

note.label: The Pride Of Thine Heart Hath Deceived Thee!

points: Before the earth was made, none spoke against God, for Israel had its celestial body.
Those not in the Lamb's book of life were not chosen from the foundation of the world.
The angel who spoke to John called himself his fellow servant and his brother.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

points: And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works. The things that he does, his example, what he does teaching the people.

note.label: SABBATH MORNING CLASS: If Thou Come to Serve the Lord

points: And by faith, whereby ye have believed, shall be preserved from the said perils, and shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders. So we have got work to do if we want to see salvation. We have got a lot of work to do, a lot of conforming of the mind to do. We have got to wash out all the dirty filth that we learned. Some people are coming in fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty years old — so you are talking about seventy years of wickedness that you have got to get out of your spirit. All ages: you have got to come in and knock that stuff out, you have got to come in and learn the Bible. It is going to be hard, but that is what the body is for. We hold each other accountable. That is why we deal with each other, that is why we have counsellors to help us get through these things.

For I have sanctified them for me from the beginning. So we have already been sanctified. Just like it says in Jeremiah chapter one and five — the Most High already knew what we were going to do. We have got to make that decision though. We have got to make sure we keep our stuff together and get better over the generations. We were already there; our spirit was already right. So we have got to get back there.

note.label: SABBATH MORNING CLASS: If Thou Come to Serve the Lord

points: Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways. We abused it. We took full advantage, we took that liberty of doing what we wanted to do, and it got us in slavery. We went completely against the Bible.
And they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments. When you stop keeping the commandments you are basically saying you are going to die.

note.label: SABBATH MORNING CLASS: If Thou Come to Serve the Lord

points: For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me. Some of you might think, oh well, I am living good, I am getting the bag, I am living straight, God is with me, I put God first. Quit lying. You put money first, you put materialistic things first. That is what you get up and pray to — the stuff that you have. You do not really care about praying to the Lord; it is in vain. That is why the Most High said, I do not want to hear your high holy days, your prayers, I do not want to hear all that stuff, because it is all in vain. You are doing it for show. You do not really mean this stuff, so quit doing it. That is why he said I would rather you be hot or cold, not lukewarm. Do not be in between playing the middle. That is going to get you killed, because now you know better but you choose not to do better.

So you have received benefits of life, great jobs, you got your family, you got the big white house, white picket fence. But guess what — the Most High did not even give you that. The devil gave you that stuff. You really think God gave you that and you are not keeping any commandments? The devil gave you all that stuff, and that is why you are going to continue to do the same thing, because you keep getting these little gifts here and there. You get the job, you think you are above everybody else, but the devil is doing that to keep you from keeping the commandments. I am not saying that about people that have houses; but you have got to know where you are getting your stuff from. Either you are getting it from the devil or you are getting it from the Most High.

note.label: SABBATH MORNING CLASS: If Thou Come to Serve the Lord

points: And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty. They hated my law. He said, you hated my law, but you had the liberty to do what I told you to do.

And, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it. So God even gives you, after you hated the laws of God, another chance to get it right. He did not just throw you away. He gave you a chance to repent from hating the law, statutes and commandments. He gave you the chance, but then again you did not want it. He gave you the liberty to do it, but you did not want repentance.

note.label: SABBATH MORNING CLASS: If Thou Come to Serve the Lord

points: The same must know it after death by pain. You do not know what the Most High is talking about, because you are going to die, and it is going to be a painful, long death.

And it is going to be some of our family members. A lot of times we get emotional, we get depressed, because my mother does not listen, I want her to be in the truth, I love my mother, why is she not getting it. You get stressed out, you start drinking, you start doing drugs, because you do not understand why your family is not coming into the truth. But you should be happy that you are. You should be happy that you are the one that God chose to come in. Everybody has their own time period, but you cannot stress out. And this is real: some of our parents are going to die in their sin. They are not going to wake up. But you were the one that did. You were the one chosen to wake up and say, all right, I am going to keep this, I am going to make my election sure, I am going to make sure my name is written in the book. That is where I want to be at. I want to secure my spot in the kingdom. I want to walk up and see the twelve gates. I want to see it and take full advantage of it — I do not want to see death by pain.

note.label: SABBATH MORNING CLASS: If Thou Come to Serve the Lord

points: I have said before, and now do speak, and will speak it also hereafter, that there be many more of them which perish, than of them which shall be saved. That proves exactly what I am saying. He said, I said it before and I am going to say it multiple times: a lot of you are going to die. There are going to be more of you that die than are saved.

We are the majority of the world now. Israel used to be the smallest nation, now we are the biggest — so a lot of us are going to die right along with our enemy, right along with the people that hate us. That is not what I am trying to be. I refuse to leave this truth. What else do I have to do? I have done everything in the world. What do I need to go back to the world for? What is there that I have not done already? Going to the club, working, twerking, sleeping with women — for what? It is unprofitable. What did that do?
You fall out the truth and next thing you know you get hit by a bus. How the hell do you get hit by a bus? Come on, man, do not play with God. We cannot play with God.

So you have got to be an example. It is not about how many scriptures you know, it is about how many scriptures you apply to your life. That is what is going to change you, that is what is going to keep you converted, that is what is going to change the soul: keeping the commandments and faith in Christ. Period.

note.label: SABBATH MORNING CLASS: If Thou Come to Serve the Lord

note.label: 2 Esdras 9: Measure Thou the Time Diligently

note.label: 2 Esdras 9: Measure Thou the Time Diligently

points: She said, I thy servant have been barren, and had no child, though I had an husband thirty years; and in those thirty years I did nothing else day and night, and every hour, but make my prayer to the Highest.

note.label: 2 Esdras 9: Measure Thou the Time Diligently

points: After thirty years God heard me thine handmaid, looked upon my misery, considered my trouble, and gave me a son; and I was very glad of him, and so was my husband also, and all my neighbours.

note.label: 2 Esdras 9: Measure Thou the Time Diligently
